issue.title: Mac Homebrew ffmpeg 8.1.2 cannot load libx265.216.dylib so sase listen cannot master MP3s
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg` on `mac` (Homebrew `ffmpeg` 8.1.2 linked against `libx265.216.dylib`)

On 2026-10-10, after correcting Bob's `highlights.listen_command` to `sase listen render …`, an isolated `sase listen render -n tone --no-publish` on `mac` synthesized chunks then failed at Master audio:

```
Could not probe ffmpeg at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg.
hint: Unset SASE_LISTEN_FFMPEG or install a working ffmpeg.
```

`ffmpeg -version` fails with:

```
dyld: Library not loaded: /opt/homebrew/opt/x265/lib/libx265.216.dylib
Referenced from: /opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/8.1.2/bin/ffmpeg
```

`x265` 4.3 is linked and ships `libx265.217.dylib` only. `brew info ffmpeg` shows installed 8.1.2 with a newer bottle 9.0.2 available. `sase listen doctor` still reports `ok: ffmpeg` because it only checks that the binary exists on PATH.

This is separate from the listen_command mismatch (now `listen_command: ok` with executable `sase`). Do not treat it as a Bob or sase-listen code bug. Repair is a Homebrew relink/upgrade of ffmpeg (or restoring a matching x265 dylib). Do not expand the listen_command config tale into that toolchain repair.

Repro:

```sh
ssh mac
zsh -lic 'ffmpeg -version'
zsh -lic 'sase listen render -n tone --no-publish -o /tmp/tone.mp3 /tmp/tone.md'
```

Impact: `bob ref create --listen` on the Mac can dispatch `sase listen` but cannot master an MP3 until ffmpeg loads.

task_type_fields.repro: zsh -lic 'ffmpeg -version' on mac; dyld misses libx265.216.dylib. sase listen render -n tone --no-publish then fails at Master audio with Could not probe ffmpeg.

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying the listen_command plugin fix on mac: tone synthesis succeeds then Master audio fails because ffmpeg's x265 dylib was upgraded out from under ffmpeg 8.1.2.
